question: Who makes Ahuacatlan Avocado Oil brand parent company
markdown:
Ahuacatlan Avocado Oil is an independent brand
of 100% pure avocado oil originating from Michoacán, Mexico—produced by
Diricom S.A. de C.V.
It is brought to North America and distributed primarily through
⁠Storino's Quality Products
, rather than being owned by a massive multi-brand food conglomerate.
